CALL {
// For each pattern
MATCH (a)
WHERE a.pattern_id IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT a.pattern_id AS pid, a.graph_id AS graph_id

// Collect nodes in A and B for this pattern
MATCH (a1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 1})
WITH pid, collect(a1) AS A, graph_id
MATCH (b1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 2})
WITH pid, A, collect(b1) AS B, graph_id
WHERE size(A) + size(B) > 2

// Create new supernodes
CREATE (newA:Node {t: 2, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})
CREATE (newB:Node {t: 1, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})

// Reconnect edges to the new nodes
WITH A, B, pid, newA, newB
UNWIND A AS oldA
MATCH (oldA)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newA)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, B, newA, newB, collect(oldA) AS oldANodes

UNWIND B AS oldB
MATCH (oldB)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newB)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, newA, newB, oldANodes, collect(oldB) AS oldBNodes

// Connect the new supernodes
CREATE (newA)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: newA.graph_id}]->(newB)

// Delete the old nodes
FOREACH (n IN oldANodes + oldBNodes | DETACH DELETE n)
RETURN pid, newA, newB
}
CALL {
  MATCH (n)
  REMOVE n.pattern_id
}
RETURN pid, newA, newB;

MATCH path = (start)-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE 
  // Even length path
  size(relationships(path)) % 2 = 0
  // All edges are unmarked Hadamard edges
  AND ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.t = 2 AND edge.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // All intermediate nodes are unmarked identity Z-spiders
  AND ALL(node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] 
          WHERE node.t = 1 
          AND node.phase % 2 = 0 
          AND degree(node) = 2 
          AND node.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // Only process unmarked start/end nodes
  AND start.pattern_id IS NULL 
  AND end.pattern_id IS NULL

// Order by path length (longest first) and node IDs for consistency
WITH path, nodes(path) as path_nodes, relationships(path) as path_edges
ORDER BY length(path) DESC, id(nodes(path)[0]), id(nodes(path)[-1])
LIMIT 1

// Mark this pattern with unique ID
WITH path_nodes, path_edges, randomUUID() as pattern_id

// Mark all edges in the path
UNWIND path_edges AS edge
SET edge.pattern_id = pattern_id

// Mark all intermediate nodes in the path
WITH path_nodes[1..-1] as intermediate_nodes, pattern_id, path_edges
UNWIND intermediate_nodes AS node
SET node.pattern_id = pattern_id

RETURN DISTINCT pattern_id, length(path_edges) as path_length

// Find all marked patterns
MATCH (s)
WHERE s.pattern_id IS NOT NULL

// Reconstruct the full path for each pattern
WITH DISTINCT s.pattern_id AS pattern_id
MATCH path = (start)-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.pattern_id = pattern_id)
AND start.pattern_id IS NULL AND end.pattern_id IS NULL AND id(start) < id(end)

WITH start, end, pattern_id,
      [node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE node.pattern_id = pattern_id] as nodes_to_delete

// Create direct connection
WITH DISTINCT start, end, nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
CREATE (start)-[newWire:Wire {t: 1}]->(end)

// Delete the nodes with the corresponding Hadamard edges
WITH nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
UNWIND nodes_to_delete AS node
DETACH DELETE node

// Return something to ensure changes were made
WITH pattern_id
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT pattern_id) as patterns_processed

// Phase gadget fusion (pyzx match_phase_gadgets + merge_phase_gadgets).
// A gadget is a degree-1 spider with a NON-CLIFFORD phase whose axel has a
// Pauli phase. Gadgets whose axels act on the same target set are merged:
// the surviving leaf gets the signed sum of the leaf phases (a pi on an axel
// negates that gadget's contribution), the surviving axel is zeroed, the
// other gadgets are deleted. Handles Z-gadgets (Hadamard wires) and
// X-center gadgets (simple wires).

MATCH (p:Node {t: 1})
WHERE degree(p) = 1
  AND p.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND p.phase % 2 <> 0
  AND p.phase * 2 <> round(p.phase * 2)

MATCH (p)-[e:Wire]-(center:Node)
WHERE ((center.t = 1 AND e.t = 2) OR (center.t = 2 AND e.t = 1))
  AND center.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND center.phase % 2 = round(center.phase % 2)

// Target set of the gadget = the axel's other neighbors, as a sorted id list.
MATCH (center)-[:Wire]-(n:Node)
WHERE n <> p
WITH p, center, e.t AS edge_type, n
ORDER BY id(n)
WITH p, center, edge_type, COLLECT(id(n)) AS neighbor_key

// Signed leaf phase: an axel carrying pi negates the gadget's phase.
WITH p, center, edge_type, neighbor_key,
     (CASE WHEN center.phase % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * p.phase AS signed_phase

WITH edge_type, neighbor_key,
     COLLECT(p) AS phase_spiders, COLLECT(center) AS centers,
     sum(signed_phase) AS signed_total
WHERE size(phase_spiders) > 1

WITH phase_spiders[0] AS survivor_p, centers[0] AS survivor_c,
     phase_spiders[1..] AS to_delete_p, centers[1..] AS to_delete_c,
     ((signed_total % 2) + 2) % 2 AS total_phase

SET survivor_p.phase = total_phase
SET survivor_c.phase = 0
FOREACH (p_del IN to_delete_p | DETACH DELETE p_del)
FOREACH (c_del IN to_delete_c | DETACH DELETE c_del)

RETURN count(*) AS fusions_performed

// Pivot boundary (pyzx match_pivot_boundary + pivot): interior Pauli Z-spider
// z_j whose neighbor z_alpha touches exactly ONE boundary (via a simple wire).
// z_alpha's phase is gadgetized (new axis + tip), z_j survives as a new spider
// re-pointed to the boundary with toggled wire type, bipartite edges between
// the neighbor groups are TOGGLED, z_alpha's other neighbors get +z_j, shared
// get +z_j+pi. ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (z_j:Node {t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND z_j.phase % 2 = round(z_j.phase % 2)

// z_alpha touches exactly one boundary, via a simple wire.
MATCH (z_alpha)-[bw:Wire]-(bd:Node {t: 0})
WITH z_j, z_alpha, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(bw) AS bws
WHERE size(bds) = 1 AND ALL(w IN bws WHERE w.t = 1)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bds[0] AS bd, bws[0] AS bw

// z_j must be interior with all-Hadamard wires, all-Z neighbors and no
// phase-gadget-tip neighbors.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[wj:Wire]-(nj:Node)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw, collect(DISTINCT nj) AS j_nbrs, collect(wj) AS j_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN j_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN j_wires WHERE w.t = 2)
  AND ALL(x IN j_nbrs WHERE degree(x) > 1)

// z_alpha's non-boundary neighbors must be Z-spiders on Hadamard wires.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WHERE na.t <> 0
WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw, j_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH z_j, z_alpha, bd, bw,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x <> z_alpha AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_j,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> z_j AND NOT x IN j_nbrs] AS only_alpha,
     [x IN j_nbrs WHERE x <> z_alpha AND x IN a_nbrs] AS shared
ORDER BY id(z_j), id(z_alpha)
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  WITH only_j, only_alpha
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND only_alpha AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_j, shared
  UNWIND only_j AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_alpha, shared
  UNWIND only_alpha AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_alpha |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + z_j.phase + 1) % 2)

// Surviving spider zj_new: takes z_j's phase, its exclusive/shared neighbors
// and the boundary wire with toggled type. Gadget: axis (phase = z_j's phase,
// because the axis sits in z_alpha's neighbor group of the pyzx pivot and
// receives +z_j) H-connected to the tip carrying z_alpha's phase. The axis
// connects to z_j's exclusive and shared neighbors (A-B and B-C toggles);
// zj_new itself is NOT connected to the gadget.
CREATE (zj_new:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis:Node {t: 1, phase: z_j.phase % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (tip:Node {t: 1, phase: ((coalesce(z_alpha.phase, 0) % 2) + 2) % 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id})
CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(tip)
CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: CASE bw.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(bd)
FOREACH (n IN only_j |
  CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n)
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  CREATE (zj_new)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n)
  CREATE (axis)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: z_j.graph_id}]->(n))

DETACH DELETE z_j, z_alpha

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

code.value:
// Interior pivot (pyzx match_pivot + pivot): two INTERIOR Pauli Z-spiders
// connected by a Hadamard edge. Interior = every wire is a Hadamard edge
// and every neighbor is a Z-spider. Toggles the complete bipartite edges
// between the exclusive/shared neighbor sets, copies b's phase onto a's
// exclusive neighbors and vice versa, adds a+b+1 to shared neighbors, then
// deletes both. ONE application per call; the driver loops.
//
// OPTIMIZED: interiorness of a and b is checked with cheap short-circuiting
// EXISTS predicates, and the O(degree) neighbour-set collection runs only
// for the single chosen pivot (after LIMIT 1) instead of for every
// Pauli-Pauli Hadamard edge in the graph.

MATCH (a:Node {t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
WITH a, b
ORDER BY id(a), id(b)
LIMIT 1

// Collect neighbour groups for the chosen pivot only (both interior, so all
// wires are Hadamard).
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)
WHERE na <> b
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)
WHERE nb <> a
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs
WITH a, b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x IN b_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

DETACH DELETE a, b

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

code.value:
MATCH (n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)--(m)
WITH n, count(m) AS degree
WITH degree, count(*) AS frequency
RETURN degree, frequency
ORDER BY degree;

// Supplementarity (type 1): two Z-spiders, not adjacent, same neighborhood,
// non-Clifford phases with sum or difference odd. Both deleted;
// neighbors' phases get +1 only when the SUM is odd (pyzx apply_supplementarity).

MATCH (v:Node {t: 1})
WHERE v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WITH v, collect(DISTINCT n) AS v_neigh

MATCH (w:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(w) > id(v)
  AND w.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND w.phase * 2 <> round(w.phase * 2)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)
  AND NOT (v)-[:Wire]-(w)

OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:Wire]-(m)
WITH v, w, v_neigh, collect(DISTINCT m) AS w_neigh
WHERE size(v_neigh) = size(w_neigh)
  AND ALL(x IN v_neigh WHERE x IN w_neigh)

WITH v, w, v_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Supplementarity (type 2): two adjacent Z-spiders with same external neighborhood,
// non-Clifford phases with sum even or difference odd (pyzx match_supplementarity).
// Both deleted; external neighbors get +1 only when the sum is even.

MATCH (v:Node {t: 1})-[:Wire]-(w:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(v) < id(w)
  AND v.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND v.phase * 2 <> round(v.phase * 2)
  AND w.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND w.phase * 2 <> round(w.phase * 2)
  AND ((v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 OR abs((v.phase - w.phase) % 2) = 1)

OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:Wire]-(n)
WHERE n <> w
WITH v, w, collect(DISTINCT n) AS v_ext_neigh

OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:Wire]-(m)
WHERE m <> v
WITH v, w, v_ext_neigh, collect(DISTINCT m) AS w_ext_neigh
WHERE size(v_ext_neigh) = size(w_ext_neigh)
  AND ALL(x IN v_ext_neigh WHERE x IN w_ext_neigh)

WITH v, w, v_ext_neigh
ORDER BY id(v), id(w)
LIMIT 1

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN (v.phase + w.phase) % 2 = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  FOREACH (n IN v_ext_neigh |
    FOREACH (__ IN CASE WHEN n.phase IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n.phase = (n.phase + 1) % 2
    )
  )
)

WITH v, w
DETACH DELETE v, w

RETURN count(*) AS supplementarity_applied

// Between two same-colored spiders, pairs of parallel Hadamard edges cancel
// (Hopf rule for graph-like diagrams).

MATCH (a:Node)-[r:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a.t = b.t AND a.t IN [1, 2]
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT r) AS rs
WHERE size(rs) >= 2
WITH rs, size(rs) - (size(rs) % 2) AS k
UNWIND rs[0..k] AS r
DELETE r
RETURN count(*) AS removed

// pyzx match_phase_gadgets normalizes every phase gadget whose axel
// carries pi: the leaf phase is negated and the axel zeroed. Running this
// before gadget fusion keeps DB results isomorphic to pyzx gadget_simp.

MATCH (p:Node {t: 1})
WHERE degree(p) = 1
  AND p.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND p.phase % 2 <> 0
  AND p.phase * 2 <> round(p.phase * 2)

MATCH (p)-[e:Wire]-(center:Node)
WHERE ((center.t = 1 AND e.t = 2) OR (center.t = 2 AND e.t = 1))
  AND center.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND abs(center.phase % 2) = 1

SET p.phase = (((-p.phase) % 2) + 2) % 2
SET center.phase = 0

RETURN count(*) AS normalized

// to_gh step 2: every X-spider becomes a Z-spider.

MATCH (v:Node {t: 2})
SET v.t = 1
RETURN count(*) AS recolored

// Second step of the bialgebra rewrite: connect the side-0 and side-1
// spiders created by 'Bialgebra rule' completely bipartitely with simple
// wires, then clear the markers.

OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Node) WHERE a.bialg_side = 0
WITH collect(a) AS side0
OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Node) WHERE b.bialg_side = 1
WITH side0, collect(b) AS side1
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(side0) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE side0 END) AS a
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(side1) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE side1 END) AS b
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN a IS NOT NULL AND b IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  CREATE (a)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: a.graph_id}]->(b)
)
WITH count(*) AS done
MATCH (n:Node) WHERE n.bialg_side IS NOT NULL
REMOVE n.bialg_side
RETURN count(*) AS cleared

code.value:
// Boundary pivot (pyzx pivot with one boundary): interior Pauli Z-spider `a`
// H-connected to Pauli Z-spider `b` that touches exactly ONE boundary; all
// other neighbors of both are Z-spiders on Hadamard edges. Performs the full
// pivot: toggles bipartite edges between exclusive/shared neighbor groups,
// copies phases (a's exclusive neighbors get b's phase and vice versa, shared
// get a+b+pi), re-points the boundary wire to `a` with toggled edge type and
// deletes `b` (`a` survives). ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (a:Node {t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)

// a must be interior
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

// b touches exactly one boundary
MATCH (b)-[be:Wire]-(bd:Node {t: 0})
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT bd) AS bds, collect(be) AS bes
WHERE size(bds) = 1
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, bds[0] AS bd, bes[0] AS be

// b's non-boundary neighbors must be Z-spiders on Hadamard edges
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[wz:Wire]-(nz:Node)
WHERE nz.t <> 0
WITH a, b, bd, be, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nz) AS b_zn, collect(wz) AS b_zw
WHERE ALL(x IN b_zn WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN b_zw WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH a, b, bd, be,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND NOT x IN b_zn] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_zn WHERE x <> a AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND x IN b_zn] AS shared
ORDER BY id(a), id(b)
LIMIT 1

CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

// Re-point the boundary wire to a with toggled edge type, delete b.
WITH a, b, bd, CASE be.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS new_t
CREATE (a)-[:Wire {t: new_t, graph_id: a.graph_id}]->(bd)
DETACH DELETE b

RETURN count(*) AS interior_pauli_removed

items.title: Pivot rule - two interior Pauli spiders original

code.value:
// Interior pivot (pyzx match_pivot_parallel + pivot): two INTERIOR Pauli
// Z-spiders connected by a Hadamard edge. Interior = every wire is a Hadamard
// edge and every neighbor is a Z-spider. Toggles the complete bipartite edges
// between the exclusive/shared neighbor sets, copies b's phase onto a's
// exclusive neighbors and vice versa, adds a+b+1 to shared neighbors, then
// deletes both. ONE application per call; the driver loops.

MATCH (a:Node {t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[wa:Wire]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs, collect(wa) AS a_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN a_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN a_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[wb:Wire]-(nb:Node)
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs, collect(wb) AS b_wires
WHERE ALL(x IN b_nbrs WHERE x.t = 1) AND ALL(w IN b_wires WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH a, b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE x <> a AND NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x <> b AND x IN b_nbrs] AS shared
ORDER BY id(a), id(b)
LIMIT 1

// Toggle Hadamard edges between the three neighbor groups.
CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

// pyzx pivot: a's exclusive neighbors receive b's phase and vice versa;
// shared neighbors receive a + b + pi.
FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

DETACH DELETE a, b

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

items.title: Pivot rule - batched interior Pauli spiders
items.description: Batched variant of the interior pivot: applies a maximal disjoint set of pivots per query.

code.value:
// Batched interior pivot: apply a MAXIMAL set of interior-Pauli pivots whose
// closed neighbourhoods are pairwise disjoint, in ONE query. Disjoint pivots
// commute, so the batch equals applying them one-by-one; this collapses the
// one-pivot-per-round-trip cost of "Pivot rule - two interior Pauli spiders".
//
// Selection (O(E) mutual-min over the claim hypergraph): each candidate pivot
// (a,b) ranks by id of its pivot edge and CLAIMS its closed neighbourhood
// {a,b} u N(a) u N(b). Each vertex is owned by the min-rank pivot claiming it;
// a pivot survives iff it owns every vertex it claims. Survivors are pairwise
// neighbourhood-disjoint, and the global-min-rank candidate always survives, so
// >=1 pivot is applied whenever any interior pivot exists (progress guaranteed).
// The per-survivor application is identical to the single-pivot query.

MATCH (a:Node {t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
WITH a, b, id(pe) AS rank
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, rank, collect(DISTINCT na) AS Na
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)
WITH a, b, rank, Na, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS Nb
WITH collect({a: a, b: b, rank: rank, claim: [a, b] + Na + Nb}) AS P

UNWIND P AS p
UNWIND p.claim AS v
WITH P, id(v) AS vid, min(p.rank) AS vmin
WITH P, collect([vid, vmin]) AS VM

UNWIND P AS p
WITH p, VM, [x IN p.claim | id(x)] AS cvids
WITH p, [pr IN VM WHERE pr[0] IN cvids | pr[1]] AS myvmins
WITH p, reduce(m = p.rank, x IN myvmins | CASE WHEN x < m THEN x ELSE m END) AS minv
WHERE minv = p.rank
WITH collect(p) AS survivors

UNWIND survivors AS sv
WITH sv.a AS a, sv.b AS b
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)
WHERE na <> b
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)
WHERE nb <> a
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs
WITH a, b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x IN b_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NOT NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    DELETE existing)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN existing IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

DETACH DELETE a, b

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed
